plain: A benefit or extra pay that comes with a job

webster.text: A fee or pecuniary allowance to an officer for services, beyond his ordinary salary or settled wages; or a fee allowed by law to an officer for a specific service, in lieu of an annual salary.

example.quote: It is honorable to be so employed, but it was never made profitable by salaries, fees, or perquisites.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 2, 1787
